fresh_uci.policy: Frozen before neural training. SHA256 order, one record per unused registrable-domain skeleton; 1000 per class. UCI original label 1=benign inverted explicitly. No predictions used.
fresh_uci.limitation: Historical same-source convenience sample, deliberately balanced; not live-web prevalence, external-source or temporal validation.

fresh_external.policy: Fixed hash sampling before predictions; max 10 official navigation paths per unused domain; one historical source-labelled phishing URL per unused domain. No outcome-based replacement.
fresh_external.limitations: Convenience international public institution, museum and academic navigation pages and historical PhishTank labels, not a population-prevalence or forward-temporal test.

ranking_source.purpose: Unlabelled frozen popularity context as learned numeric features. Presence/rank never directly sets a verdict. Both malicious and benign URLs may use ranked domains.
ranking_source.time_limitation: Ranking snapshot is later than historical URL labels; this is not forward-temporal validation.

fusion_training.policy: Frozen v4 encoder and forest. Fit on expanded official navigation, internal calibration and all earlier inspected completion cohorts; SHA256 group split, review groups exclude upstream encoder train/selection. HistGradientBoosting 150 rounds, leaves15/31, official weights1/3/10, seeded training-only rank masking0/.25/.5; validation-only balanced accuracy with FPR<=.02/recall>=.95 preference. Review uses unmodified actual context. No test-driven changes.

limitations: Academic local-demo validation only. Repeated research revisions and convenience samples are disclosed; no population accuracy, calibrated web-risk probability or production guarantee.
